map.name: Build & Decode
map.testedVersion: Static/source revalidation against current Drive artifact v1.1.3; runtime retest still required where stated.

bugs.title: Authored final-standings presentation is not used at match completion
bugs.problem: The current artifact still contains a dedicated final-standings UI for the end of a game, but the completed-match flow does not call it. The flow settles the result, sends the match summary as chat text, and proceeds directly into arena reset.
bugs.expected: The authored end-of-match presentation is reachable from the completed-match flow so players receive a clear terminal result before the arena resets and returns them to the lobby.
bugs.observed: In v1.1.3, GuessTheBuildUI.showFinalStandings() is still implemented, while ArenaService.finish() settles the result, calls game.say(game.matchSummary()), and then immediately awaits resetArena(). Repository/source inspection found no production caller for showFinalStandings().
reproduction: Complete a normal Build & Decode match.
Observe the terminal result after the final round completes.
Check whether the authored final standings presentation appears before the arena resets and players return to the lobby.
bugs.aiAnalysis: The presentation capability exists but is disconnected from the terminal match lifecycle. Result settlement remains owned by ArenaService; the missing link is presentation after settlement and before reset. Runtime retest should confirm the player-visible behavior on v1.1.3.

relevantCode.reason: Defines showFinalStandings() as a dedicated final standings ActionForm.
finish() settles the result, sends matchSummary() as chat, then calls resetArena() without invoking showFinalStandings().

bugs.suggestedFix: Route completed matches through the existing final-result presentation after durable result settlement and before arena reset. Presentation should consume the already-settled result rather than recalculate winners.
mustPreserve: Exact-once result settlement and leaderboard persistence.
Correct team Win/Draw semantics from the canonical result.
Automatic cleanup and return to lobby after the presentation window.
